name: Monochro no Umi o Tadayou Hito
original_name: モノクロの海を漂う人
source:
A certain senpai was always found in the library.
"I'm looking for my destined partner."
I talked to such a strange person when it was after school.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18261]official site[/url]]
translation:
图书馆里总能找到某个前辈。
“我正在寻找我命中注定的伴侣。”
放学后我和一个奇怪的人交谈过。

[翻译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18261]官方网站[/url]]
